The query "who is the chief economic advisor" is underspecified, so multiple valid answers apply depending on the administration and role. As of 2025, under President Trump, **Stephen Miran** serves as Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), confirmed by the Senate on March 12, 2025, with Pierre Yared and Kim Ruhl as Members [d1][d2][d6]. Separately, **Kevin Hassett** serves as director of the National Economic Council (NEC) — a distinct advisory body — in Trump's second term [d5][d7][d8]. Under President Biden, **Jared Bernstein** served as CEA Chair, with Heather Boushey and Kirabo Jackson as Members [d9][d4]. During an earlier period of Trump's first term, **Tyler Beck Goodspeed** served as Acting Chairman of the CEA, and Kevin Corinth served as Chief Economist [d3].
